name: anti-locale-toolkit
description: One-click multilingual localization toolkit for Antigravity Desktop

scripts.check: node --check scripts/patcher.js && node -e "for (const f of ['locales/zh-TW.json','locales/zh-CN.json']) JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync(f, 'utf8')); console.log('AntiLocale Toolkit 檔案檢查通過')"
